sub_sector.value: Product lifecycle management; CAD; application and service lifecycle software

software_category.detail: Product lifecycle management, CAD, engineering calculations, application and service lifecycle management, enterprise asset management, augmented reality, asset intelligence, and collaboration.

deployment_model.detail: On-premises engineering software alongside SaaS product development offerings such as Creo+ and Windchill+.
